heading.title: Of Contracts, Voidable Contracts and Void Agreements

article.title: Who are competent to contract.
article.content:
11Who are competent to contract.

Section 11  ·  Chapter II  ·  page 13 of the Act
Every person is competent to contract who is of the age of majority according to the law to which he is subject3, and who is of sound mind, and is not disqualified from contracting by any law to which he is subject.
3 See the Indian Majority Act, 1875 (9 of 1875).
